description: Java class 'HttpUtils' providing utility methods for extracting and inspecting HTTP request headers and authorization info within a specific security context, primarily using Akka HTTP model classes.

classes.name: HttpUtils
classes.description: Utility class with static methods to handle HTTP header extraction, request header parsing, and authorization checks within Akka HTTP request context.

methods.name: getRequestHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific header from the HTTP request, wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Extracts and returns all headers and cookies from a RequestContext as a custom RequestHeaders object.

methods.name: containsAuthorizationForPrefix
methods.description: Checks whether the request contains an Authorization header starting with a specified prefix.

methods.name: basicAuthUsernameMatches
methods.description: Verifies if the username in Basic HTTP Authorization header matches a given regex pattern.
